info.name: AlayaCare Accounting Accounts EVV Export API
Get a list of EVV exports created filter by `claim_destination_system`, `export_type` and `status_of_background_jobs`

params.name: claim_destination_system
params.description: Claim destination system associated with the EVV Export

items.docs: Get a list of EVV exports created filter by `claim_destination_system`, `export_type` and `status_of_background_jobs`

info.name: Create an initial EVV export record for the `claim_destination_system` and `export_type` selected for a specific `branch_id` or default branch if none specified.  The returned schema's `created_at` date will be used as the end of the date range for visits retrieval.

items.docs: Create an initial EVV export record for the `claim_destination_system` and `export_type` selected for a specific `branch_id` or default branch if none specified.  The returned schema's `created_at` date will be used as the end of the date range for visits retrieval.

info.name: Get full EVV export record.  This can be called for a "retry export" event, in case of initial failure.

items.docs: Get full EVV export record.  This can be called for a "retry export" event, in case of initial failure.

info.name: Update EVV export record.  This will only be called once, after the EVV export is complete (either as success or failure), and will contain all the information about the export.

items.docs: Update EVV export record.  This will only be called once, after the EVV export is complete (either as success or failure), and will contain all the information about the export.

info.name: Get the date and time of the latest EVV export for the `branch_id`, `claim_destination_system` and `export_type` selected, returned from the record of the most recent file that was exported, regardless of its status.  If no record is found a default date is returned instead.

info.name: Get the date and time of the latest EVV export using the Export ID

items.docs: Returns the date and time from the record of the most recent file that was exported prior to `evv_export_id`, regardless of its status.  If no record is found the default date is returned.
